description: Lists the card and sticker printers whose upload sizes the kit knows: each one's id, the formats it takes with the exact pixel size, file type and dpi, how it wants card backs, and the page those sizes came from with the date they were checked. Call it when the user names a printer or says the cards are going to a print house; pass the id as printHouse to export_open_design_artifact. When their printer isn't listed, export print images at 300 dpi and tell them to check the size against the printer's upload page. Read-only.
name: list_open_design_print_houses
